name: Irmen Tarnor
keeps: the arithmetic nobody else wants to do
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: He confessed unprompted to crimes nobody had accused him of.
text: Irmen tarnor of the counted step, keeps the book for the 11th tranche, doors 96 to 104. Keeps the arithmetic nobody else wants to do. Reads Major Thomas Weir.
